summary: Skyline Builders Group Holding Limited, a Hong Kong-based foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K on August 17, 2026, announcing completed acquisitions of two Nevada gold and silver mineral properties: Mill Creek for US$100,000 and Irwin Mine for US$36,000. The purchases were made through Global Critical Minerals, LLC, per purchase and sale agreements with Paramount Gold Nevada Corp. and Stream Metals LLC, dated July 7, 2026. The agreements include royalty terms and conditions. This is a strategic acquisition of mineral property. What to watch: integration, future production potential, and any development milestones.
